11048 likháti 'scratches' AV., 'writes' Yājñ. [√ likh ] Pa. likhati 'scratches, carves, writes'; Aś.shah. likhapeśami , man. likhapita -, gir. likhāpisaṁ , dh. likhiyisāmi 'will write', NiDoc. lihati , Pk. lihaï , MB. lihe , Or. lihibā , M. lihiṇẽ , Ko. liuṁk , Si. liyanavā , caus. liyavanavā ; Md. liyāka sb. 'writing'. * alikhant -. Addenda: likháti . 1. WPah.poet. līṇo 'to draw, write', Md. liyanī (absol. lī ), liyum 'writing'. 2. † likhyatē 'is written' Kathās.: OP. likhaṇu 'to
write', P. likhṇā , B. lekhā , H. likhnā . † likhyatē see likháti . * liṅga- ² 'defective' see * likka - Add².
html:
